title: Engineering Incident Response Runbook
body: Severity levels: Sev1 (full outage or data loss, page immediately, open an incident channel), Sev2 (major degradation, page on-call, incident channel optional), Sev3 (minor/contained, file a ticket, no page). Every Sev1/Sev2 gets a written incident review within 3 business days (see PAY-2114 for a worked example) covering timeline, root cause, customer impact, and action items. The incident commander is whoever first acknowledges the page unless a more senior engineer explicitly takes over.
